The only network activity is downloading the four source images the brief supplies by URL, which the task requires.

overall.summary: A genuinely original editorial world: the four images are cut into a vertical-slat collage that the display type sits inside rather than on top of. This is the brief's 'do not put the images in rectangles' instruction taken seriously.

standards.summary: 2,910 lines across 15 files with the movement choreography isolated in a 747-line stylesheet, so the visual system is editable without touching component logic.

findings.title: Movement stylesheet is the single largest file
findings.detail: src/styles/movements.css carries 747 lines of keyframes and slat geometry. It is coherent, but the per-movement blocks would be easier to reason about split by movement, matching the component split that already exists.

strengths: 41 ARIA attributes on a page that could easily have shipped as decorative divs
Choreography lives in CSS rather than in JavaScript timers
No randomness, so the composition is identical on every load

specification.summary: All four supplied images are used as raw material rather than as content blocks, the experience is structured as five movements with four inks, and the brand reads as a coherent fictional house.
strengths: Images sliced into vertical slats that shear on scroll, so no image appears as a rectangle
Display type layered inside the collage with a warm offset shadow
Editorial furniture (edition of 500, atelier of atmospheres, descend cue) builds the fiction
Model name carried in both the document title and the hero

ux.summary: The first frame is arresting and the scroll cue, movement counter and running footer give the reader a map of a page that is deliberately unconventional.

findings.title: Hero body copy sits over a busy region of the collage
findings.detail: The right-aligned paragraph overlaps the sculpted bust and drapery. It is readable at 1440px, but there is no scrim behind it, so contrast depends on which slat lands underneath at a given viewport. Add a subtle gradient scrim under that block.

strengths: DESCEND cue and INKS IV counter orient the reader immediately
Slat seams give the composition rhythm without decoration
Typographic hierarchy holds at hero scale
Works at desktop and mobile widths
